verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Postman works with API specifications: Spec Hub is used to design API structure, the CLI generates SDKs from API specifications and lints or governs specs. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents importing an OpenAPI file and generating requests or collections from it, so that core step is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit docs on OpenAPI import, documented spec-to-collection/request generation, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
